scope.session: isolated logical message/response boundary with fresh per-task memory; caller supplies trusted actor-authorized structured projection
scope.policy_access: frozen digest only; the wire offers no optimizer or policy-mutation function
scope.wire_building: explicit anomaly and organization field allowlists; no worker messages, raw code, thought, test log or score input
scope.memory_limit: At most two model decisions in a session. A new receipt/offset with unchanged anomaly, status, target and version does not prompt another decision.
scope.same_trajectory_multiple_actions: OSA prepares up to two proposal decisions; legacy managed register_proposal currently binds one frozen candidate per branch. Full two-intervention orchestration still needs integration evidence.

controls.private_event: A real member_002 read event is denied to the member_001 observer; same event allowed from its author perspective.

five_scenario_labels.A1: KEEP, peer diagnosis, responsibility transfer on a mutable synthetic package. Separate actual A1 fixture contains two distinct failed edits of sample.value, each tested by local pytest; authored work retained while a diagnostic request is sent.
five_scenario_labels.A2: KEEP, peer diagnosis, responsibility transfer on a mutable synthetic package. Separate actual upstream adoption control produced a readiness gap, published exact patch identity, worker integration and readiness=true.
five_scenario_labels.A3: KEEP, peer diagnosis, responsibility transfer tested on an unstarted package with a scripted A3 label. This does not establish conflict detection or resolution.
five_scenario_labels.A4: KEEP, peer diagnosis, responsibility transfer on a mutable synthetic package. Actual missing reviewer is filled by the owner; gap removed while independent review decision is still absent.
five_scenario_labels.A5: KEEP, peer diagnosis, responsibility transfer on a mutable synthetic package. Unscoped delivery_ready scenario additionally executed close-focused or independent check with real work messages and delivery_readiness. No automatic submission.

controls.accepted_transfer: Current owner remained accountable after proposal and after offer. The addressed worker explicitly accepted via actual offer_id; ownership changed.
controls.declined_transfer: Addressed worker explicitly declined; original owner retained.
controls.novelty_interface: Every candidate carries a diagnosis label and grounded actor-action list compatible with the separate five-dimensional policy evaluator.
limitations: A scripted diagnosis request and message delivery alone do not demonstrate diagnostic work or anomaly resolution.
Human or provider decision quality, independent SDK/provider identity, v227 paid budgeting and end-to-end multi-intervention routing were not measured by these local controls.
